conditions.CF_UNL: Recent-reference weather with unconstrained cooling demand
conditions.HW_UNL: Heatwave weather with unconstrained cooling demand
conditions.HW_RATED: Heatwave weather with rated cooling capacity
conditions.HW_C70: Heatwave weather with 70% of rated total cooling capacity
conditions.HW_O24_SYNC: Heatwave weather with a synchronized 24-hour grid interruption

synchronized_interruption_clock.selection_rule: For each event, select the heatwave-period interval with the highest outdoor temperature in the common event weather series.
synchronized_interruption_clock.application: The selected event-specific clock is applied to every design and is not tailored to prototype schedules or building outcomes.
